text:
lia: Heads up — customer reported duplicates after a flurry of 429s when their client rotated API keys. They saw the same webhook POST twice.
omar: Did they use idempotency keys?
lia: They did for the POSTs but only for the synchronous code path. The streaming helper doesn't attach the header.
jade: Typical parity gap. Node and Go attach the header in streaming helpers, Python sampleapp doesn't.
omar: Also in their traces the client retried immediately on 429 while a refresh call was inflight. Two concurrent sends within 200ms.
lia: So two failure modes stacked: missing idempotency header + unsafe immediate retry during refresh.
ci-bot: @devex created ticket DEVEX-2291 for 'sdk parity: streaming idempotency + refresh guard'.
alex: Short-term mitigation: recommend customer set server-side idempotency enforcement and enable client-side jitter/backoff. We should give them a snippet they can drop in.
jade: Proposed quick snippet for sampleapp (JS): ```js
// small guard around token refresh to prevent replay
let refreshInFlight = false;
async function sendWithGuard(req) {
  if (refreshInFlight) await sleep(randInt(120, 260));
  return await sendWithJitteredRetry(req);
}
async function startRefresh() { refreshInFlight = true; await refresh(); refreshInFlight = false }
```
omar: For SDKs: add (1) always attach Idempotency-Key for side-effectful helpers, (2) if refresh starts, queue immediate requests for 200-300ms, (3) on 429 do exp backoff + randomized jitter.
lia: We should also expose a small opt-in flag: client.safe_replay = true that enables the queue/lock behavior for customers worried about dangerous side-effects.
ci-bot: @devex opened PRs: node-sdk#412, go-sdk#198, python-samples#77.
alex: Telemetry idea: emit metric "retry.during_refresh" with tags {sdk, client_id, route}. That will help correlate with duplicated side-effects.
jade: Agree. Also add a validation in sampleapps that asserts idempotency header present for POSTs that claim to be idempotent. Could fail in dev mode.
omar: Priority: patch sampleapps + Node/Go SDK helpers this week. Python sample and docs next week. Lia can draft the customer response.
lia: I'll write the response with recommended mitigations and link the PRs + a short rollback plan. Template: 1) enable server idempotency 2) upgrade SDKs or apply sampleapp guard 3) enable retry telemetry 4) file an incident if duplicates continue.
alex: One more: add a short note in onboarding checklist: "confirm idempotency enforcement on server and SDK parity for streaming helpers".
lia: Thanks everyone — moving to action items.
ci-bot: job replay-guard-ci started -> https://ci.internal/replay-guard/4202
